solomon.bio: Solomon Nyangweso Omwenga is a visionary software engineer and the Chief Technology Officer (CTO) of Solian Wolves. He leads the engineering division, architecting high-performance enterprise systems and scalable cloud infrastructures.

ian.bio: Ian Momanyi Nyakundi is the Chief Executive Officer (CEO) of Solian Wolves. He provides the overall corporate vision, strategic leadership, and executive direction for the company's global operations.

hillary.bio: Hillary Onchwati Isaiah is the Chief Operating Officer (COO). He oversees day-to-day internal business operations, service delivery, and strategic planning across all departments.

alice.bio: Alice Moraa Nyakundi is the Chief Financial Officer (CFO). She oversees financial planning, budgeting, accounting practices, and the strategic management of revenue pipelines.

noella.bio: Noella Maraka Kaatho is the Executive Director of Finance & Admin. She supports financial operations, budget tracking, and human resources workflow execution.
